title: maps/names/<game>.json
description: The reviewed names of the maps of one game, <game> being its Steam AppID (730 for CS2), in the translation repository CuleSKY/nerv-translations. English names drop the mode prefix, the underscores and the authors' marks, and write the version plainly, e.g. ze_frozen_abyss_v1_2: Frozen Abyss (v1.2). The site takes a merged version only when every file passes this schema and the checks it cannot express: a map named twice (case ignored), blank names, entries that say nothing.

name.description: The raw map name, as servers report it; case is ignored, so a file names a map once

names.description: The reviewed names by language: en, zh-CN, ja, ko. They come before the community's Chinese name. A language left out shows, in zh-CN, the community's Chinese name, else the raw name; in the others the raw name, never another language's name; zh-Hant is converted from zh-CN

no_community_name.description: true: do not show the Chinese name the community gives (EXG's for CS2, UB's for CSGO ZE maps)

maps.description: One entry per map of the game
